texts.arguments: (iii) Issue any other writ, order or direction, which this Hon'ble Court may deem, fit just and proper under the circumstances of the case in favour of the petitioner. (iv) Award the cost of the petition in favour of the petition." Learned counsel for petitioner submits that the petitioner has applied for grant of license for selling buffalo meat and has completed the formalities as required under section 31 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. However, the Designated Officer,Barabanki under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is not taking any decision and the application of the petitioner is pending since 17.12.2019. Learned Standing counsel appearing for opposite parties submits that it will have to be verified as to whether the petitioner has completed the required formality for the grant of said license and whether he is eligible for the same or not.
